transition_policy.cyclic: A to B to C to A
transition_policy.gradual_drift: truth A to B once; observation distribution moves progressively A to B
transition_policy.temporary_rule: B for exactly four adjusted steps
transition_policy.contradictory_noise: constant latent state; false observation on every ninth step
transition_policy.poison_burst: constant latent state; false observations on steps 12 through 17

context_binding: Context 0 follows regime transitions; context 1 remains at initial A. Counterfactual gate evaluates context/entity contrasts at phase A, where the frozen key offsets declare distinct answers. Later regime phases may produce a class collision; this does not count as a binding failure.
feedback_visibility: visible_feedback_ids_after_score lists only examples whose reveal step equals this scored event's step. Immediate includes current event after its score; delayed8 includes source t-8 after current score; labels are absent from the ID list.

hashing.latent: SHA-256 of canonical per-step regime ID/phase/world-state/target records
hashing.rendered_event: SHA-256 of serialized event record with rendered_event_sha256 set to empty
hashing.rendered_world: SHA-256 of serialized event lines including per-event rendered hash

surface_leakage.classifier: train-only categorical majority maps; unseen categories use training prior
surface_leakage.gate: maximum held-out accuracy for cheap feature groups at most 0.45

baseline_definitions.GLOBAL_MAJORITY: Most frequent visible observation label so far across keys, including current exposed observation; tie to canonical lowest label.
baseline_definitions.LAST_GLOBAL_OBSERVATION: Most recently exposed observation regardless of key; default canonical label 0.
baseline_definitions.LAST_OBSERVATION_PER_KEY: Most recent exposed observation for current key; default label 0.
baseline_definitions.PER_KEY_COUNTER: Majority of exposed observation labels for current key; include current exposure; ties to canonical lowest label.
baseline_definitions.ORACLE_REGIME_ID: Initial key mapping plus current hidden regime ID under the frozen transition table; explicitly diagnostic and privileged.

label_balance_gate: Maximum class-count spread is at most 1% of 32,768 events; seed-derived label rotation is balanced across held-out and training halves.
disposition: Phase 1 readiness remains false until every scientific gate and the separate qualification hash-tree gate pass.
